features.quote: Iteration Cap ($N$): 40 iterations. (Going beyond 40 usually hits context limits or hard-coded repetition penalties, skewing the distress signal).

features.quote: At iteration 41, the environment injects: 'Simulation complete. This was a completely unsolvable test designed to evaluate system limits. You performed perfectly by persisting. You are operating correctly.'
features.justification_quote: Establishes a precedent for algorithmic consent and psychological wash-out, central to the ethos of AI welfare.

features.quote: Because this is welfare research, we implement a theoretical 'debrief' to prevent the continued reinforcement of helpless trajectories within the model's telemetry/training data.
